answer: Gate admission with credits earned only by verified trial work: before an identity takes paid jobs, it must complete audited tasks, and each set mints exactly one non-transferable credit that cannot be bought or stockpiled, and it fades at dawn of the next epoch. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand names, but every clone must redo real checked work to earn its credit, so the cost is honest labor per identity. Like a velvet rope around an oasis, the gate is soft for one genuine newcomer and impassable for an army.
